title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Star Plaza Theatre, Merrillville | 1999
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Star Plaza Theatre in Merrillville, Indiana, USA, on 26 February 1999.

It was the 11th show by the fifth All-Starr Band. Their US tour lasted for 30 dates in February and March 1999.

Starr had previously performed at the Star Plaza Theatre on 8 July 1995.

The fifth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, percussion
  • Gary Brooker: vocals, keyboards, organ
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Timmy Cappello: vocals, saxophone, keyboards, harmonica, guitar
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums

Concert setlist

  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘Whisky Train’ (Gary Brooker)
  • ‘Shooting Star’ (Simon Kirke)
  • ‘Sunshine Of Your Love’ (Jack Bruce)
  • ‘I Saw The Light’ (Todd Rundgren)
  • ‘Boys’

  • ‘Bang The Drum All Day’ (Todd Rundgren)
  • ‘White Room’ (Jack Bruce)

  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
